evidence.detail: The class extends JFrame and is the exact frame instantiated and owned by ClientUI for the live game window.

In ALWAYS containment mode, overridden setLocation/setBounds clamp the frame to its active GraphicsConfiguration bounds; monitor/device/inset calculations also constrain maximized and transformed bounds.
Dedicated width-add/remove methods are called by ClientUI when toolbar/sidebar/plugin panels appear or disappear and apply FrameResizeMode plus monitor-edge logic before changing frame bounds.
The frame directly stores both FrameResizeMode and FrameContainmentMode state and applies them in its positioning/sizing paths.

proposals.note: ContainableFrame is fixed by exact JFrame role plus monitor-containment and sidebar-aware sizing behavior. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The enum preserves exact constants ALWAYS, RESIZING and NEVER.

ContainableFrame stores this enum and checks it in frame-location/bounds and panel-width adjustment logic; ALWAYS directly clamps the frame to the current graphics-device bounds while NEVER bypasses related edge handling.
The live window-settings config returns the RESIZING value as its default containment behavior.

proposals.note: FrameContainmentMode follows exact surviving enum constants and their direct monitor-containment behavior in ContainableFrame. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The class owns the live Client, ConfigManager/window settings, EventBus, ContainableFrame, game applet panel, navigation toolbar/sidebar panels and current plugin panel.
Its Swing initialization creates ContainableFrame, applies icon/title/tray/window-decoration state, embeds the client, restores window/sidebar state, and shows/manages the main game window.

It handles NavigationButtonAdded/Removed events, exact 'Open SideBar'/'Close SideBar' controls, CardLayout plugin-panel switching, and calls ContainableFrame width-add/remove methods as side content changes.
The class preserves exact UI persistence keys 'runelite', 'clientBounds', 'clientMaximized' and 'clientSidebarClosed'.
It posts ClientShutdown through EventBus, waits for consumers, stops the client, and owns window attention/focus/cursor behavior.

proposals.note: ClientUI is fixed by exact ownership of the main client frame, game canvas, sidebar/navigation/plugin panels, persisted window state and shutdown lifecycle. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The enum preserves exact constants KEEP_WINDOW_SIZE and KEEP_GAME_SIZE with exact display strings 'Keep window size' and 'Keep game size'.
ContainableFrame stores this enum and branches on it in the width-add/remove methods used when UI side content changes.
KEEP_WINDOW_SIZE preserves the frame size where possible while KEEP_GAME_SIZE expands/contracts the frame with sidebar/plugin width so the game-content size is retained.
